title: rbac-v2: enforce region-pinned KMS keys and audit log enrichment
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Customers operating under regional data residency requirements requested stricter guarantees that customer encryption keys (KMS) and audit logs remain pinned to the configured region. Motivation: RBAC v1 allowed policy-level KMS references without validating region affinity which caused two incidents of cross-region key usage in private deployments. This PR extends RBAC v2 to validate and enforce KMS region pins at policy evaluation time, adds audit log enrichment to surface KMS region and policy decision metadata, and ships a migration that flags non-compliant policy bindings. Summary of changes: 1) rbac/v2: introduce RegionConstraint in policy schema and runtime enforcement in policy evaluator; 2) kms: add region_enforcer component that validates key ARN/ID against tenant region mapping and resolves multi-region aliases; 3) audit: add log_enricher to include kms_region, policy_id, decision_reason in structured audit events; 4) migrations: SQL to add kms_region column on policy_bindings and backfill using key metadata; 5) api/console: expose region pinning in settings and validation UX; 6) tests: integration and unit coverage for positive/negative region-pin cases and fallback behavior. Rollout plan: feature is behind feature flag feature.rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce (default off). We will deploy the evaluator + audit_enricher in canary mode, run a sampling rollout to 5% of private deployments, and surface policy violations as warnings in the console. After 2 weeks of monitoring and automated backfill fixes, flip enforcement to blocking for new policy writes. Migration notes: add migration 20251130_add_kms_region_constraints.sql which adds kms_region varchar to policy_bindings and runs best-effort backfill; non-backfilled bindings are marked with region="unknown" and surfaced in the console for manual remediation. Backwards compatibility: policies without RegionConstraint continue to behave as before while the feature flag is off. When enforcement is enabled, writes that reference keys in a different region will be rejected with a clear error and remediation link. Testing: unit tests for policy evaluator, integration tests with private-installer payloads, and a canary run against two internal clusters. Security review: static analyzer (snyk/gosec) ran and flagged an AWS ARN parsing edge-case which is addressed by stricter validation and additional tests. Documentation: docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md explains behavior and migration steps. Related: ENG-1987, SEC-402, SUP-1182. Checklist: [x] schema change migration added; [x] evaluator enforcement implemented; [x] audit enrichment implemented; [x] integration tests added; [x] docs updated; [x] feature-flag gated; [x] security review complete.

release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports region-pinned KMS keys and audit log enrichment; Migration: adds kms_region to policy_bindings and backfills best-effort (see migration docs); Behavior: enforcement behind feature flag and rolled out via canary before blocking writes; Ops: UI surfaces non-compliant policies for remediation; Note: no immediate breaking changes while feature flag is off.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature.rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce=false by default. To enable enforcement set environment variable RBAC_V2_KMS_ENFORCE=true and run migration 20251130. Monitor audit.kms_region and policy_violation metrics. Backfill tool available at migration/backfill_kms_region.sh
testing_summary: Unit: 56 tests added for evaluator and ARN validation; Integration: 4 end-to-end tests covering canary run; Load: lightweight canary against two internal clusters with 10k simulated auth requests; Security scans re-run after fixes.
notes_for_reviewers: Key review points: migration safety (idempotent backfill), evaluator performance (decision path microbenchmark <500ns avg added latency), audit payload size caps, and UX for remediation links in console.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental enforcement could reject valid policies for keys with stale metadata; Mitigation: enforcement behind flag, best-effort backfill and unknown-region warnings, ability to disable enforcement per-tenant during rollout.
